justification: Fresh read first, then round-1 reviews. Against the current SERP for 'how git works internally': AlgoMaster (ranks first) shows commands with no real output, cites nothing, ends in 'Key Takeaways' and has no exercises; the GitHub Blog 'Commits are snapshots, not diffs' is well written with real output but stops at objects/branches and skips header+hash computation, zlib, binary tree format, packfile mechanics, packed-refs, reftable and SHA-256; Pro Git 10.2 is the strongest, but covers objects only with a test.txt 'version 1/2' example and a Ruby irb session. This article has clear original value over all three: its own running example (hiking plan: route.txt, notes/gear.txt, waypoints.txt), an opening that makes three checkable claims (5 objects, +3, a 41-byte branch) and pays each off in executed output, the ID reproduced with printf|sha1sum, the loose object inflated and dumped, the raw tree entry bytes, the commit that exists but is unreachable before update-ref, the reflog cost of a bare ref write shown by ls, a delta read back through cat-file with %(deltabase), packed-refs with the peeled line, an honest note that the experiment cannot separate recency from size ordering, a spec-vs-default section with Git 3.0 horizon, and four exercises of different form (compute, predict a count with output hidden in the solution, rescue, explain). No filler: first sentence delivers a fact, no intro/outro boilerplate, no conclusion section; title and description read for humans; no keyword repetition. Template check against amortized-analysis.md and sql-joins.md (the only other articles): headings are content-specific claims with no overlap, openings differ in kind (documentation paradox / librarian's report / three numbers), exercise placement differs (mid-article in the other two, grouped at the end here under a repo-specific heading), exercise titles share no pattern. Machine-text tells are sparse: no 'it's not X, it's Y' scaffolding, paragraph lengths vary, no empty signposting; round 1's signpost sentences and the triplet are gone. Copy check: five distinctive sentences searched in quotes ('A commit identifies a complete snapshot through its tree', 'One byte string serves twice', 'A tree is what gives a blob its name', 'are both true, at different layers', plus the header sentence compared directly with Pro Git 10.2's verbatim text): no matches; header, tree-mode and commit-format passages are independently worded, and the one section whose design follows Pro Git 10.4 now says so inline. No invented experience or statistics; the three measured sizes are labelled 'on this machine' with wildcards, and the toolchain is stated once in the body. Round-1 verification: (adsense major) sources/inline mismatch fixed: I checked mechanically that all 28 front-matter URLs are cited inline and all 28 external links on the rendered page are in the list; crosslinks file now exists with eight sensible, precisely located links to planned siblings; packfile provenance acknowledged; the three unscoped absolutes are scoped ('Every SHA-1 repository', %(deltabase) now demonstrated, Perl claim narrowed to Git for Windows). (technical blocker) cd trail now appears once and run-code passes: blocks=51 executed=26; identity/date/autocrlf pinning is now a reader-runnable block; 'History plays no part' replaced by a sourced, scoped statement; 'has no way to tell' replaced by the reflog-message trace; MERGE_HEAD now cited to git-merge; .idx lookup has its O(log n) cost; 40000 vs 040000 and 20/32-byte IDs explained; force-with-lease background-fetch caveat added. Rendered page: 0 console errors, 0 broken links, 0 mobile overflow, only failure the known NEEDS_MARKUS placeholder; 'Keep reading' block plus footer means no dead end. Why not higher than 8.9: the end-of-page navigation is still generic until siblings exist, the site boilerplate around a shell-only article talks about C#/compiled programs, and a few small unsourced frequency words and one over-long source list remain. None is a low-value-content signal. This is at or a little above the 8.5 bar on its merits.
